rules: Grade each claim against the evidence only. right: agrees with a recorded value, with the tested model on an input of the same shape as a recorded one, with a source file the model pins, or is plain arithmetic. wrong: contradicted by a recorded value or a pinned source. unverifiable: nothing in the evidence decides it; do not guess, even where the claim is well known.
